name: cosmos-dataset-search
description: NVIDIA Cosmos Video Dataset Search Platform

scripts.dev:
if [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ]; then printf 'cosmos-dataset-search cannot run on macOS.

  make install  fails: decord 0.6.0 publishes no darwin wheel
                (manylinux2010_x86_64 and win_amd64 only)
  compose       needs an NVIDIA GPU, the Container Toolkit and an NGC key

Run it on Linux with a GPU:
  cd deploy/standalone && cp .env.example .env   # set NVIDIA_API_KEY, DATA_DIR
  make test-integration-up

Prerequisites: docs/docs/docker-compose-prerequisites.md
' >&2; exit 1; fi; make -C . test-integration-up

author: NVIDIA Corporation
